notes: Bundle: Claude.app 2.42304.2 (build 2.42304.2), bundle id com.anthropic.claudefordesktop, Electron 44.7.2, Team ID Q6L2SF6YDW, minimum macOS 13.0, URL schemes claude and msauth.com.anthropic.claudefordesktop. Sources: calibrate probe --ade claude-desktop, codesign -dv /Applications/Claude.app, Contents/Info.plist.

The Code tab is the Claude Code surface of the desktop app and its UI is served from claude.ai: the main window loads a remote URL (claude.ai / claude.com strings in app.asar .vite/build/index.chunk-BkhOOUzl.js). No layout code for the composer or the message column exists locally, so every rect here is an estimate for 1600x1000 points.

openProject: the app's own route for a folder is claude://code/new?folder=<path>&source=os_open (app.asar .vite/build/index.chunk-BkhOOUzl.js: QL(Fl.Code,'/new','os_open',{folder:e}) builds it and the folder drop handler FMa dispatches exactly it; protocol claude: comes from CFBundleURLTypes). steps.openProject opens that URL with open, which CALIBRATE.md ranks above an open step with args. It needs a signed-in account (same file, qXn). Alternative by hand: open -a /Applications/Claude.app <folder>, which uses the public.folder document type and lands in the same route.

newThread: Cmd+N is the menu item New Session in the Code surface (accelerator CmdOrCtrl+N, the label is picked by Ixi() between New Task and New Session; index.chunk-BkhOOUzl.js) and the documented Code tab shortcut (code.claude.com/docs/en/desktop, Keyboard shortcuts: Cmd N New session). It only creates a session for the Code surface, so openProject must run first.
send: Enter sends and Shift+Enter adds a line (code.claude.com/docs/en/desktop, Use the prompt box). The composer is remote UI, so this is not readable from the bundle.

Permission mode cannot be pinned through ~/.claude/settings.json from a profile: reset() writes reset.jsonKeys and then restores the clean snapshot as its last step, and the snapshot owns ~/.claude/settings.json (bench/core/snapshot.ts INCLUDED_PATHS), so a defaultMode written there is overwritten at once. Setting permissions.defaultMode is documented for the desktop app, so this is a harness ordering problem, not an app limitation.

Agent binary: the app provisions Claude Code into its data folder, not the bundle: ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude-code/2.1.295/<hash>/claude.app/Contents/MacOS/claude (239 MB). That is 2.1.295, not the system 2.1.303, and the app has no setting for a CLI path, so METHODOLOGY.md rule 8 cannot hold: record the version from each request's User-Agent.

reset moves ~/Library/Application Support/Claude aside, which also removes that provisioned Claude Code, so the first launch after a reset re-downloads it. If the night runs offline, keep the folder or pre-seed it. ~/.claude is never moved: ADES.md 3.16 says the CLI shares it and the harness owns it through the clean snapshot.

login.files: config.json holds oauth:tokenCache and oauth:tokenCacheV2 (top-level key names only were listed, no values read), so it is the file that keeps the sign-in; Cookies and Local Storage keep the claude.ai web session for the same window. The cookie encryption key lives in the login Keychain, which a reset does not touch.

Auto-update: Squirrel/ShipIt (Contents/Frameworks/Squirrel.framework). The only switches in the bundle are the managed settings autoUpdate.disabled (flatKey disableAutoUpdates) and autoUpdaterEnforcementHours, which arrive by MDM or managed configuration, so a profile cannot set them. ShipIt is not a launchd service in this account (launchctl print gui/501/com.anthropic.claudefordesktop.ShipIt: Could not find service, exit 113; bootout exits 3), so calibration.launchAgents and processes.launchAgentLabels stay empty: bootout() throws on a non-zero exit and would break every reset.

Telemetry: the desktop settings schema has a telemetry category (otlpEndpoint and friends) and the Claude Code engine honours DISABLE_TELEMETRY and CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TELEMETRY (app.asar index.chunk-j3ja_Cdp.js). Nothing readable turns the desktop app's own analytics off without managed settings, so this profile does not switch it off; record it as a Track F fact unless the owner changes it in the ademark account.

Orchestration: the Code tab has subagents (Agent SDK Task tool) and cross-session messages (docs: let Claude check on, message, or archive your other sessions; ADES.md 3.16). No trigger line exists in the bundle: the slash commands, skills and plugins come from the server. orchestrationTrigger is null, so C1 reports not supported. The orchestrator must decide whether to send a trigger line (it changes the prompt for this ADE alone) or keep null.

processNames is only the main executable. Every helper (Claude Helper, Claude Helper (GPU)/(Plugin)/(Renderer), Claude iOS Sim) lives inside the bundle and pidsFor also matches by bundle path, so attribution and quit cover them.

Updater: ShipIt installed 3.6556.2 at 05:02 as root (the owner typed a password; the bundle then belonged to the owner's account). Pinned 2.42304.2 was put back from pins/ and now belongs to ademark, so no ownership or admin prompt. Since then every check logs '[updater] Auto-update error: Error: The command is disabled and cannot be executed' and nothing is downloaded. CLAUDE_E2E_MANAGED_PLIST is honoured only in E2E builds (globalThis flag), so disableAutoUpdates cannot be set without root. Check the version before and after each gate.

Quit: steps.quit is empty (AppleScript quit, then the 10 s wait). Gate 2026-10-24 run 1: a keys quit step failed in A1 and A2 with 'ademark-native keys failed (exit 2): bad_arguments: --pid must be a positive pid' (no app pid there). After quit about 34 attributed processes stayed alive past 10 s (Claude Code sessions).

BLOCKER for Track A (gate 2026-10-24): the app does not use the replay server. Each local session gets ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL set by the app itself to its API host (index.chunk-BkhOOUzl.js iJ(): ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL: e.apiHost; VZe lists ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL among the variables the app controls), so launchd's ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL never reaches the engine. A4 frames show the real model's answer to replay:hi ('Hi! I'm in the Ledger repo...') instead of LEDGERMARK, and A11's replay:long-2000 got a real answer that asked a question (sidebar 'Blocked Replay long 2000 Asked a question'). Only an app-level custom API host (managed config, root) or a harness-side redirect (for example mitmproxy) can fix it; a profile cannot.
